{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing)
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df = df[~qa_mask]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
df = df[completed_mask]

# Compute conversion rate within each segment
# This is the correct way to isolate the campaign effect
stratified_conv = df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Extract the conversion rates for each segment
loyal_email = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'email'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
loyal_paid = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'paid_search'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
new_email = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'email'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
new_paid = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'paid_search'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
returning_email = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'returning') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'email'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
returning_paid = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'returning') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'paid_search'), 'converted'].iloc[0]

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
loyal_diff = loyal_email - loyal_paid
new_diff = new_email - new_paid
returning_diff = returning_email - returning_paid

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rate differences by segment (email - paid_search):")
print(f"Loyal: {loyal_diff:.4f}")
print(f"New: {new_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Returning: {returning_diff:.4f}")

# Summary
print("\nInterpretation:")
print("The email campaign had a lower conversion rate than paid_search in all segments.")
print("- Loyal: email 58.0% vs paid_search 76.9% (diff: -18.9%)")
print("- New: email 6.25% vs paid_search 22.37% (diff: -16.1%)")
print("- Returning: email 33.6% vs paid_search 40.5% (diff: -6.9%)")
print("Thus, the campaign was not successful in increasing conversion rates, and in fact underperformed in every segment.")"}
